fix: patch router ABI selectors to match deployed bytecode

The deployed AdumbraRouter has different function selectors than
standard keccak256 encoding of the source code function signatures.
This was caused by the contract being compiled from an older source
version with different struct field names.

Changes:
- Add DEPLOYED_SELECTORS mapping with actual bytecode selectors
- Replace refreshNonce() readContract with raw eth_call using
  correct selector (0xaffed0e0 instead of 0x2c31112c)
- Replace executeSwap writeContract with encodeFunctionData +
  selector patch (0x9de44d55 instead of 0x4d04dbf8)
- Add encodeFunctionData to viem imports
